name: labs/snhobbs__hp894xx
title: HP 89400 series vector signal analyzer (HP894xx.HP89400Device)
intro: HP 89400 series vector signal analyzer (HP894xx.HP89400Device), adapted from snhobbs/hp894xx. It reads `center_frequency`, `span`, `x_units`, `y_units` and 5 more; runs `acquire_spectrum`, `abort_measurement` and `enable_autorange`. `acquire_spectrum`: read one trace: start a data read, return the Y values and the X/Y metadata the analyzer reports. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/snhobbs__hp894xx --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/snhobbs__hp894xx --backend fake --mcp
